top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation by chemically induced proximity is a transferable molecular design rule: a small molecule recruits an E3 ligase to a target so the cell destroys it. The cereblon glue lineage has years of approved clinical use with an established mechanism (Handa identified cereblon), and the PROTAC strand is two decades old and widely reproduced. It opens a mechanistically distinct area, with no overlap with the 2020 CRISPR prize. Reservations: no heterobifunctional PROTAC is approved yet, and Ciulli is left out by the three-name cap. Base editing (P001) is a close second with clear attribution, but its increment over 2020 and short record weigh more for me.
